evidence.excerpt: Rakić is currently co-supervising two PhD students under DRIFTGUARD and has limited capacity for new long-term commitments before mid-2025. She is particularly interested in partners who can provide access to real labelled or partially labelled sensor datasets, which are the main bottleneck for her research. She prefers collaborations where the company has an internal technical contact who can validate domain assumptions.
